meta.name: Gen:Lock
meta.description: Fifty years in the future, an oppressive authoritarian force threatens to conquer the world. A daring team is recruited to pilot a new form of weaponized neuroscience that powers devastating mecha, but they must be willing to sacrifice everything to save the world.

videos.title: The Pilot
videos.overview: Earth, 2068. City by city, free society is being forcibly absorbed into a vast autocracy. One military force holds the line. One pilot could turn the tide.

videos.title: There's Always Tomorrow
videos.overview: Earth, 2072. Chase tries reconnecting with Miranda and the Vanguard. Doc’s new recruits arrive with more than a few questions and one perilous secret.

videos.title: Second Birthday
videos.overview: The Colonel raises concerns about Doc’s residency. Chase feels the impact of absence. The new recruits are introduced to the potential of using gen:LOCK mecha for combat.

videos.title: Training Daze
videos.overview: The gen:LOCK team begins rigorous training to master their mecha. The recruits get better acquainted during a rare moment of downtime. While on the gen:LOCK team’s first field mission, a new threat emerges from the shadows.

videos.title: The Best Defense
videos.overview: A recruit’s talent for tinkering raises concerns. Chase receives an overdue upgrade. The Vanguard goes on the offensive and engages a frighteningly familiar foe.

videos.title: The Only Me I Know
videos.overview: Doc reflects on past events before deciding his future. The gen:LOCK team is tested like never before when the battle arrives at the Vanguard’s front door.

videos.title: It Never Rains...
videos.overview: On the run, the team learns more about the origins of gen:LOCK and one another. New potential allies are revealed.

videos.title: Identity Crisis
videos.overview: The team must evolve further if they hope to make a stand against the Union’s deadliest weapon.

videos.title: When the Leaves Began to Turn
videos.overview: As the Union’s Holon army nears the Polity’s final stronghold, Chase preps his team for what could be gen:LOCK’s last stand.

videos.title: The First Strike
videos.overview: In 2068, the war between the Union and the Polity begins with a shocking strike on a major stronghold. As Yaz joins the resistance movement, Chase confronts a shocking truth.

videos.title: Buried Pain Grows Poison Trees
videos.overview: While General Marin orders a much-needed reprieve, Chase considers the complex implications of his discovery, and Miranda angles for a promotion. Then, a figure from the Polity’s past emerges from the shadows.

videos.title: Together. Together.
videos.overview: As the battle to reclaim the Anvil approaches, Cammie clashes with her teammates, while Val bonds with Kazu. Later, Chase uncovers a dark truth.

videos.title: The Grand Guignol
videos.overview: General Marin’s ruthless tactics come into question while the gen:LOCK team mourns one of their own. Later, Cammie’s search for answers leads her to Babylon.

videos.title: The Third Way
videos.overview: As the gen:LOCK team prepares for their raid on RTASA, Miranda hatches a plan to appeal to Chase’s emotions, while General Marin confronts the Polity’s latest plot.

videos.title: Twilight
videos.overview: As Miranda and Chase head to New York to face off against the Twilight, Cammie and Caliban near a breakthrough that could help Henry crack gen:LOCK’s code.

videos.title: Touch What's in Front of You
videos.overview: As the Twilight ravages New York, Chase and the members of gen:LOCK face a fatal decision that could finally seal humanity’s fate.

videos.title: A First Look
videos.overview: The newest gen:LOCK recruits have arrived at the Vanguard military base “the Anvil,” and are ready to settle in! That is until Doctor Weller explains there's a few more tests to endure before they're fully accepted into the program… See what's in store for the team when gen:LOCK premieres January 26, 2019 only on Rooster Teeth!

videos.title: Michael B. Jordan on his character Julian Chase
videos.overview: You know Michael B. Jordan loves anime - now get an exclusive look at his experience voicing Julian Chase in Rooster Teeth's newest animated show gen:LOCK.

videos.title: Michael B. Jordan on Anime
videos.overview: As a long-time anime fan, Michael B. Jordan has a lot to say about the genre. Find out how he got into giant robots, who his favorite villain is, and even settle the greatest anime debate of all time.

videos.title: Michael B. Jordan Answers Classic Rooster Teeth Questions
videos.overview: Is a hotdog a sandwich? Is water wet? Michael B. Jordan weighs in on the hard-hitting questions Rooster Teeth has been debating for years.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes
videos.overview: What goes into the making of a new animated show? Hear from some of the creators behind gen:LOCK as they share their experiences and inspiration for Rooster Teeth's newest series.
